quote: Eye sizes and interdistances: AME 0.38, ALE 0.22, PME 0.07, PLE 0.23, AME–AME 0.08, AME–ALE 0.04, PME–PME 0.92, PME–PLE 0.35, AME–PME 0.60, AME–PLE 0.95, ALE–ALE 0.81, PLE–PLE 1.07, ALE–PLE 0.76.
note: Anatomy only; no visual function is claimed. 'Eye sizes' is not defined in the Methods or elsewhere (no eye-measuring sentence; Methods mention eyes only in abbreviation glosses), so filed as sensory_anatomy, as Jingneta qishan (desk-d322, audit 433) and Zoica (desk-d357, audit 471). One record per labelled eye, this one the PME. Other male-holotype sentences mention only 'Eye bases surrounded by black pigment(ation)'. Registry: WSC species page (wsc.nmbe.ch/spec-data/72194) prints Synagelides kangding K. K. Liu, 2025, Salticidae Blackwall, 1841, accepted, no synonymy. Licence: the page prints 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' (read in pieces); Crossref list query: license http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, content-version vor, issued 2025-07-15, volume 1245, pages 243-267, authors in the order printed. The sentence was returned in two pieces joined at the comma after AME–ALE. Not on main (grep of the whole docs/ tree for Synagelides and 154908: no hits). The page gives the year only (2025).

method: measurement of the preserved male holotype as listed in the species Description (headed 'Male (holotype, Sal-412)'); Methods print 'All measurements were taken with a stereomicroscope using the AxioVision SE64 Rel. 4.8.3 software and are presented in millimeters.' (no statement of how eye sizes are taken)
conditions: Male holotype Sal-412 (ASM-JGSU), Caiyuanzi Village, National Highway G318, Kangding City, Ganzi Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan Province, China, 2399 m, 26 July 2023, K. Liu, Z. Jiang & Y. Yao leg.; the same sentence gives all four eye sizes (AME 0.38, ALE 0.22, PME 0.07, PLE 0.23) and interdistances; female paratype 'Eye sizes and interdistances: AME 0.32, ALE 0.22, PME 0.07, PLE 0.22, ...'.
